title: MoveWallResult
description: One wall run moved and its host rebuilt from the new path; the host GUID is kept when the wall stays one solid.

wall.description: The run as the receipt names it: the north wall, or the wall at (x, y).

normal.description: Unit normal of the run, east or north.

faces_before.description: The two faces along normal, mm, before the move.

openings_moved.description: Marker GUIDs of the openings that moved with the run.

followed.description: The walls joined to the run that stretched or shortened with it (F2).

forsk_id.description: The record the wall stands in.

wall.description: Its name before the move: the east wall, or the wall at (x, y).

change_mm.description: How much longer it got; shorter is below 0.

records.description: The forsk ids of the wall records written. More than one when records that share ends followed.

rebuilt.description: What followed besides the walls: floor, roof, rooms.
